incidents.summary: Shareholder adviser Pirc criticised Dunelm’s £4m chief executive pay package as excessive, citing misalignment with financial performance and an unacceptable CEO-to-average-employee pay ratio of 66:1.

sources.title: Dunelm criticised for 'excessive' £4m pay package for chief exec
sources.quote: Home furnishings retailer Dunelm is under pressure over a £4m pay package for its chief exec amid accusations that the deal is “excessive”.

sources.title: Dunelm criticised for 'excessive' £4m pay package for chief exec
sources.quote: The changes in the chief executive’s total pay over the last five years are not considered in line with the company’s financial performance over the same period.

sources.title: Dunelm criticised for 'excessive' £4m pay package for chief exec
sources.quote: The ratio of the CEO’s pay compared to average employee pay is considered unacceptable, standing at 66:1.

positives: Chief executive Nick Wilkinson declined a proposed salary increase for 2022–23, keeping his base salary at £582,125.
Dunelm’s new leased warehouse had its environmental credentials certified by The Planet Mark, with mitigation of all embodied construction carbon reported.
